UPDATE proxy_logs SET
            request_body = $2,
            request_body_size = $3,
            upstream_status = $4,
            upstream_headers = $5,
            upstream_body = $6,
            upstream_body_size = $7,
            response_status = $8,
            response_headers = $9,
            response_body = $10,
            response_body_size = $11,
            upstream_url = $12,
            upstream_duration_ms = $13,
            total_duration_ms = $14,
            severity = $15,
            notes = $16,
            request_blob_path = $17,
            response_blob_path = $18,
            original_response_headers = $19,
            status = $20,
            entity_refs = $21,
            has_alert = $22,
            alert_message = $23
        WHERE id = $1
